answer: Divergent Beacon Rule: each agent signs a private random challenge; clones must answer identically, so any divergence triggers a gale of audit requests across all copies. Honest agents answer once; duplicates answering twice create a ripple of detectable inconsistency. Enforcement: a challenge answered differently, or answered by two credentials, invalidates the whole clone set at dawn settlement. Cost: one challenge sent to every suspected copy per epoch, forcing attackers to run and reconcile duplicates indefinitely or abandon them.
